voice.microphoneDenied: I need the microphone to hear you. Please allow microphone access in your phone settings, then try again.

lesson.intro: This lesson has {{count}} cards. Say next to go on, back to go back, or repeat to hear a card again. Say help at any time.
lesson.help: You can say next, back, repeat or help. To answer, say the letter of your choice, like A or B. On scam cards, say scam or legit.
lesson.notUnderstood: Sorry, I did not catch that. Say repeat to hear the card again, or say help.
lesson.complete: Well done. You finished the lesson. Say back to hear the last card again.
lesson.optionNotAvailable: Please say one of these letters: {{letters}}.
lesson.sayNext: Say next to go on, or repeat to hear the card again.

askKiko.prompt: Ask me any money question now.
askKiko.nothingHeard: I did not hear anything. Let's try again when you are ready.
askKiko.confirmRetry: Please say yes to add the lesson, or no to skip it.
askKiko.confirmHelp: Say yes to add this lesson to your path. Say no to skip it. Say repeat to hear the question again.
askKiko.adding: Okay. I am adding the lesson to your path.
askKiko.declined: Okay. I will not add the lesson.
askKiko.notAdded: I did not add the lesson. You can ask me again at any time.
askKiko.error: Sorry, something went wrong. Please try again.
askKiko.addFailed: Sorry, I could not add the lesson. Please try again later.
